title: purple-mimi step 4: design corrections found while building
description: From the step 4 skeleton (purple-mimi bd75d299, 2026-11-22): (1) mimid's runner logs a failed sync but does not tell its embedder, so a lost stream can't be reported as MIMI_ERR_NETWORK; needs a mimid hook. (2) The runner's tasks can't be aborted from outside; past the grace period the store and its lock are kept until process exit. (3) A stale takeover request would make every later holder release at once; purple-mimi added a freshness rule (older than wait + 5 s is ignored and deleted). (4) The holder's pid isn't recorded, so MIMI_ERR_LOCKED can't name it. Record in docs/design/purple-mimi.md §6/§7.4 and fix (1), (2), (4) in mimid. Remaining step 4 work: cbindgen header, both C glues, CMake, CI, README, LICENSE/SPDX/THIRD-PARTY, headless smoke test (podman images ci/debian13 and ci/purple3 exist in the repo).
design:
Plan (2026-11-22). Three mimid-side fixes; each premise verified against code.

(1) Report a failed sync to the embedder.
    Premise: crates/mimid-agent-store/src/runner.rs:201-208 matches
    store.sync() and on Err only logs agent_sync_failed; nothing reaches
    the caller. purple-mimi.md §7.4 requires "if the reopen fails, the
    library reports MIMI_EV_DISCONNECTED with MIMI_ERR_NETWORK", which
    the embedder cannot do today.
    Fix: a second hook trait beside BeforeSync (runner.rs:79), called
    after each pass with the outcome. Runner::start takes
    Option<Box<dyn BeforeSync>> positionally (runner.rs:106), and
    RunnerOptions cannot carry a hook (it is Clone+Debug, runner.rs:45).
    So introduce RunnerHooks { before_sync, after_sync } and have start
    take it in place of the Option. Only two call sites:
    crates/mimid-agent/src/daemon.rs:388 and
    crates/mimid-agent-store/tests/groundwork.rs:730.
    Tests: a hook sees Ok with the report; a hook sees Err when sync
    fails; the daemon still runs with no hooks.

(2) Abortable runner tasks.
    Premise: Runner::join (runner.rs:135) consumes self and awaits each
    JoinHandle with no timeout and no abort. purple-mimi.md §6.3 item 8
    requires waiting up to 10 s for work in flight and item 9 requires
    dropping what is still running; §6.3 item 10 then needs the last Arc
    reference, which a live task holds. Today the store and its
    StateLock are kept until process exit.
    Fix: Runner::join_within(grace: Duration) -> RunnerStop, which waits
    up to grace, then aborts the rest; the returned value names which
    loops had to be aborted so the embedder can report it (§6.3 item 10
    reports MIMI_ERR_INTERNAL and keeps the lock). Keep join() as
    join_within(forever) so daemon.rs is unchanged.
    Tests: a loop blocked past the grace period is aborted and named; a
    loop that ends inside the grace period is not aborted; after
    join_within the store's Arc is droppable.

(3) The holder's pid in the lock file.
    Premise: crates/mimid-agent-core/src/lock.rs opens the lock file
    with truncate(false) and never writes it; AgentError::Locked
    (crates/mimid-agent-core/src/error.rs:76) carries only the path. So
    purple-mimi.md §6.3 item 4's text "process <pid> if known" can never
    know it.
    Fix: after locking and the inode check, write std::process::id() to
    the file (truncate, write, no fsync needed: advisory only). On
    TryLockError::WouldBlock (lock.rs:92) read the file best-effort and
    put the parsed pid in AgentError::Locked as holder: Option<u32>.
    Add #[non_exhaustive] to the variant at the same time (the enum has
    it, the variant does not), so a later field is not breaking.
    The pid is advisory and untrusted: a message only, never a decision
    (a pid can be stale or reused). Document that in the module's
    Limitations.
    Tests: a refused lock names the holder's pid; a lock file with
    garbage or empty content still refuses cleanly with holder: None;
    the file stays 0600 after the write (lock.rs:161 covers the mode).

(4) Not a mimid fix: the stale-takeover freshness rule is purple-mimi's
    own (core/src/takeover.rs already records pid and nonce). Record it
    in docs/design/purple-mimi.md §6.3, and record (1), (2), (3) in
    §6.3/§7.4 as the mimid side they now rely on.

Gates: all six, per AGENTS.md. Each fix starts with its failing test.
notes:
2026-11-22 progress.

Item 1 (AfterSync hook) DONE: mimid-agent-store runner.rs gains the AfterSync trait and RunnerHooks { before_sync, after_sync }; Runner::start takes RunnerHooks in place of Option<Box<dyn BeforeSync>>. Call sites updated: mimid-agent daemon.rs, the groundwork test. Test the_runner_reports_each_sync_outcome_to_the_hook forces a real SyncError::Save with a Frontend that refuses, and asserts both Ok and Err reach the hook.

Item 2 (abortable runner) DONE: Runner::join_within(grace) -> RunnerStop aborts the loops still running past the grace period, names them, and awaits each aborted task so every loop has dropped its store reference before returning (what purple-mimi.md §6.3 item 10 counts on). join() is now stop_within(None). Test a_loop_past_the_grace_period_is_aborted_and_named uses a BeforeSync that never returns and asserts Arc::strong_count(&store) == 1 afterwards.

Item 3 (stale takeover freshness) DONE as documentation: the rule is purple-mimi's own and already in its takeover.rs. Recorded in purple-mimi.md §6.3 items 2 and 6: fresh for the wait plus 5 s (35 s), a stale request ignored and deleted by whoever finds it, with why.

Item 4 (holder pid) WON'T DO: Mark decided 2026-11-22 against exposing a holder at all (decision mimid-1wgh.90). Implemented, then reverted in full; lock.rs keeps only a Limitations bullet saying the lock names no holder, and purple-mimi.md §6.3 item 4 drops the '(process <pid> if known)' clause.

Gates with items 1 to 3 plus item 4 before the revert: all six clean, 2011 passed / 0 failed / 4 ignored. Re-running after the revert.

Remaining on step 4 (purple-mimi repo, not mimid): cbindgen header, both C glues, CMake, CI, README, LICENSE/SPDX/THIRD-PARTY, headless smoke test.
